CustomField.description: Formula text: CASESAFEID(Form_Template_Page__r.Form_Template__c). Surfaces the grandparent Form Template Id directly on the section without a Page-lookup query, available in before-insert/before-update contexts. Used by triggers/utilities (e.g. enforcing Section Tag uniqueness within a template) and reporting. System-derived; not editable.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Read-only Id of the Form Template this section ultimately belongs to, calculated from the parent page. It updates automatically; you do not set it.
CustomField.label: FormTemplateId
